warnings: 1. During using product or after use, if there are any abnormal symptoms or side effects such as red spots, swelling or itching in the area of use due to direct sunlight, consult with a specialist. 2. Refrain from using on areas with scars, etc. 3. Precautions for storage and handling A) Keep out of reach of children B) Store away from direct sunlight
